name_zh: 图恩贝里/瑞典/气候/罢课/弗里达/全球/青年/诺贝尔/气候正义
description_zh: 格塔·玛丽·图恩贝里（2003-），瑞典气候活动家，学校罢课运动领导者，2018年开始气候抗争，领导全球青年气候罢课运动，支持弗里达运动，气候正义倡导者，其气候活动对全球气候行动产生深远影响。
description_en: Greta Thunberg (2003-), Swedish climate activist, school strike movement leader, started climate resistance in 2018, led global youth climate strike movement, supported Friday movement, climate justice advocate, her climate activism profoundly influenced global climate action.
